name: Asta

ASTA_TOKEN.description: Optional Asta API token for the asta CLI and skills; leave blank and run `asta auth login` instead.

postCreateCommand: if [ "${CODESPACES:-}" = true ]; then mkdir -p /workspaces/.asta-auth "$HOME/.config" && chmod 700 /workspaces/.asta-auth && if [ -d "$HOME/.config/asta-cli" ] && [ ! -L "$HOME/.config/asta-cli" ]; then { cp -an "$HOME/.config/asta-cli/." /workspaces/.asta-auth/ || :; } && chmod -R go-rwx /workspaces/.asta-auth && if (cd "$HOME/.config/asta-cli" && find . -exec sh -c 'src_root=$(pwd -P); dest_root=/workspaces/.asta-auth; for path do target="$dest_root/$path"; if [ -L "$path" ]; then [ -L "$target" ] && [ "$(readlink "$path")" = "$(readlink "$target")" ] || exit 1; src_link=$(realpath -m "$path") || exit 1; dst_link=$(realpath -m "$target") || exit 1; case "$src_link" in "$src_root") [ "$dst_link" = "$dest_root" ] || exit 1 ;; "$src_root"/*) [ "$dst_link" = "$dest_root/${src_link#"$src_root"/}" ] || exit 1 ;; *) [ "$src_link" = "$dst_link" ] || exit 1 ;; esac; elif [ -d "$path" ]; then [ -d "$target" ] && [ ! -L "$target" ] || exit 1; elif [ -f "$path" ]; then [ -f "$target" ] && [ ! -L "$target" ] && cmp -s "$path" "$target" || exit 1; else exit 1; fi; done' sh {} +); then rm -r "$HOME/.config/asta-cli" && ln -sfnT /workspaces/.asta-auth "$HOME/.config/asta-cli"; else echo "Asta auth migration found conflicting files between $HOME/.config/asta-cli and /workspaces/.asta-auth; compare and resolve them manually, then rebuild to retry. Existing credentials remain in both locations" >&2; fi; else ln -sfnT /workspaces/.asta-auth "$HOME/.config/asta-cli"; fi; fi && npx --yes skills@latest add /opt/asta-plugins --all -g --yes

postAttachCommand.auth: if [ "${CODESPACES:-}" = true ] && [ -d "$HOME/.config/asta-cli" ] && [ ! -L "$HOME/.config/asta-cli" ]; then echo "Asta auth is not persisted: compare $HOME/.config/asta-cli with /workspaces/.asta-auth, resolve conflicting files, then rebuild the container" >&2; fi
postAttachCommand.preview: if [ -n "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}" ]; then url="https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-4848.${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN:-app.github.dev}/"; else url=http://localhost:4848/; fi; echo "Quarto preview: $url"; curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:4848/ || { [ -f Makefile ] && make preview; } || { [ -f _quarto.yml ] && quarto preview --no-browser --port 4848; } || true
